- generic: Question 31 of 47 · Incidents and reporting
  - heading "Within what time can you promise to inform a customer about an incident that may affect them?" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Choose a deadline you can keep at night and on holiday. A customer covered by NIS 2 must send an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident, which is why customers write a deadline into the contract.
